mapper.select: SELECT rv.*, r.res_name, r.res_code, r.res_type, r.location, r.quantity AS resQuantity, r.capacity, r.res_status AS resStatus, e.emp_name, d.dept_name, ap.emp_name AS approvedEmpName FROM reservation rv JOIN com_resource r ON rv.res_id = r.res_id JOIN employee e ON rv.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN employee ap ON rv.approved_emp_id = ap.emp_id WHERE rv.rev_id = #{revId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( rev_id, res_id, com_id, emp_id, quantity, status, start_dt, end_dt, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( seq_reservation.NEXTVAL, #{resId}, #{comId}, #{empId}, #{quantity}, 'WAI', #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update:
UPDATE reservation
quantity = #{quantity}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, remark = #{remark},
WHERE rev_id = #{revId} AND status = 'WAI'
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'APP', approved_emp_id = #{approvedEmpId}, approved_at = SYSDATE, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE rev_id = #{revId} AND status = 'WAI'
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'REJ', approved_emp_id = #{approvedEmpId}, approved_at = SYSDATE, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE rev_id = #{revId} AND status = 'WAI'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE com_id = #{comId}) AS resvTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE com_id = #{comId} AND status = 'WAI') AS waiTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE com_id = #{comId} AND status = 'APP') AS appTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE com_id = #{comId} AND status = 'REJ') AS rejTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE com_id = #{comId} AND status = 'NORET') AS noRetTotal FROM dual
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE res_id = #{resId} AND status IN ('WAI', 'APP', 'NORET')

SELECT r.rev_id, res.res_id, res.res_code, res.res_name, res.res_type, e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.emp_mobile, r.start_dt, r.end_dt, r.return_dt FROM reservation r JOIN com_resource res ON res.res_id = r.res_id JOIN employee e ON e.emp_id = r.emp_id WHERE r.status = 'APP' AND r.noshow_alert_at IS NULL AND ( -- 차량 / 장비 : 반납 예정시간이 지났는데 반납 처리가 안 된 경우 (res.res_type IN ('VEHICLE','EQUIPMENT') AND r.end_dt < SYSTIMESTAMP AND r.return_dt IS NULL) OR -- 회의실 : 시작시간은 지났고 종료시간 전인데 이용 흔적이 없는 경우 (res.res_type = 'ROOM' AND r.start_dt < SYSTIMESTAMP AND r.end_dt > SYSTIMESTAMP AND r.return_dt IS NULL) ) ORDER BY r.end_dt ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.noshow_alert_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) END FROM reservation r JOIN com_resource res ON res.res_id = r.res_id WHERE res.res_type = #{resType} AND r.status IN ('APP', 'NORET')
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET return_dt = #{returnDt}, updated_at = SYSDATE, status = 'APP' WHERE rev_id = #{revId} AND emp_id = #{empId} AND status IN ('APP', 'NORET') AND return_dt IS NULL

UPDATE reservation r SET r.status = 'NORET', r.updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE r.status = 'APP' AND r.return_dt IS NULL AND r.end_dt < SYSTIMESTAMP AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM com_resource res WHERE res.res_id = r.res_id AND res.res_type IN ('VEHICLE','EQUIPMENT') )
